transcription.final_text: The patient has complained of bilateral knee pain for five years. The pain increased two years ago. A plain x-ray showed advanced grade four osteoarthritis. Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and muscle relaxants were given for approximately one month, resulting in mild improvement. The patient is now performing physiotherapy exercises and is scheduled for a follow-up in two weeks.
